## rebar-debug finding: ALREADY FIXED on origin/main (duplicate of landed 0514-92e0-e6c4-4304)

Investigated per the /rebar-debug protocol against a fresh worktree at origin/main
(d007c76b53d5). The reported defect is a genuine defect, but it has **already been fixed** and
the fix is an ancestor of origin/main. No live defect remains.

**Proof (verified on current origin/main):**
- `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/last_pass.py` no longer composes `repo_root/".tickets-tracker"`.
  The `.env-id` read now goes through `_store_dir(repo_root)` -> `rebar.config.tracker_dir(repo_root)`
  (the canonical resolver that returns `REBAR_TRACKER_DIR` verbatim / honours `tracker.dir`), and the
  detail file is `DETAIL_IN_STORE = Path(".bridge_state/last-pass.json")` joined onto the resolved
  store. The hard-coded `DETAIL_RELATIVE` constant is gone.
- Reproduced the ticket's deployment (REBAR_TRACKER_DIR set to an out-of-tree dir, populated
  `.env-id`): `bridge_status()` returns a snapshot (dict) instead of raising, and
  `resolve_environment_id()`/`_store_dir()` resolve to the out-of-tree tracker -- not
  `repo_root/.tickets-tracker`.
- Regression test present and green: `tests/interfaces/facades/test_bridge_status_relocated_store.py`
  (5 passed) -- sets REBAR_TRACKER_DIR out-of-tree and asserts bridge_status returns a snapshot,
  with an in-tree control arm (satisfies AC4/AC3).
- Class guard present and green: `scripts/check_tickets_boundary.py` (wired into `make lint`, exit 0)
  prevents any new hard-coded `.tickets-tracker` path composition from regrowing (satisfies AC5/DD2).

**AC status:** AC1 done, AC2 done, AC3 done, AC4 done, AC5 done / DD1 done, DD2 done -- all satisfied by the landed fix.

**Landing commit:** `1a589bdfc2a882f09160530655f06077764b33d8` -- "Resolve the ticket store instead of
composing it", trailer `rebar-ticket: 0514-92e0-e6c4-4304` (the broader closed ticket already
linked `duplicates` this one). It routed all 13 hard-coded call sites through the resolver.

**Defect origin (caused_by):** `b69c-5787-81b8-4052` -- commit `fe5a447061cd` ("Add durable bridge
status and canary witness") introduced `last_pass.py` with the hard-coded `.tickets-tracker/.env-id`
path (shipped bypassing the existing `config.tracker_dir()` resolver). This matches 0514's own attribution.

**Parity/class sweep:** the fix's `make lint` boundary guard IS the structural class check; it passes
on origin/main, so no sibling hard-coded `.tickets-tracker` path-composition remains in `src/rebar`.

**Disposition:** duplicate / already-fixed. No code change to land. Recommend closing this ticket as
a duplicate of 0514-92e0-e6c4-4304.
